title: Religious-Adjacent / Cultic / Occult / Anti-Religious Master Blueprint
purpose: Standardize records for traditions, cults, mystery cults, esoteric movements, occult orders, initiatory societies, anti-religious worldviews and historical deity cults that do not fit cleanly into the main religion registry.
classification: Analytical classification only. 'Cult', 'occult', 'secret society', 'anti-religion' and 'sect' are not automatically judgments of legitimacy, danger or truth.
mandatory_integrity_rules: Do not call an ancient deity a modern religion without evidence of a living tradition.
Do not infer child sacrifice, Satan worship, criminality or abuse merely from hostile sources.
Do not treat medieval accusations of secret societies as proof of their alleged activities.
Separate ancient cult practice from modern occult revival and modern aesthetic appropriation.
Separate a group's self-designation from labels applied by opponents or journalists.
Record disputed etymologies and chronologies as disputed rather than selecting a convenient answer.
A small population does not make a tradition historically insignificant.
Secret or initiatory does not mean undocumented; use surviving constitutions, membership records, texts, buildings and correspondence where available.
No blank fields are used in completed records; unavailable information is represented by an explicit evidence statement such as 'no reliable surviving evidence identified'.
Modern groups using an ancient symbol are not automatically continuations of the ancient cult.
